update.available: A new version v{{version}} is available (current v{{current}})
update.downloaded: Update file saved: {{path}} (run or replace the saved file to apply)
update.applied: Update applied. Restart the app to use the new version
update.applyFailed: Could not apply the update (you can download it manually): {{error}}
update.restartFailed: The update was applied, but restarting failed. Please restart the app: {{error}}

preview.title: Preview
preview.hint: Click an area to select it; Ctrl/⌘+click to select several. Drag to move, drag a corner or edge handle to resize. Tab to an area and use the arrow keys to move it 1px (Shift+arrow: 10px). A multi-selection moves together and snaps by its bounding box. Tile numbers are the order SeedQueue places instances in. All values are stored as whole pixels.
preview.keyboardHelp: Arrow keys move by 1px, Shift+arrow keys by 10px.
preview.snapInfo: What dragged items snap to. Background = shape and manually placed image layers; Layout = area edges and centers. Canvas edges and center are always included unless set to None. Nothing snaps to the side whose boxes are hidden. Hold Shift to disable snapping.

sidebar.resizeHint: Drag to resize (double-click to reset). Arrow keys also work

import.title: Import
import.description: Load a .zip resource pack or an already-extracted resource pack folder. A resolution selector will open during import.
import.descriptionWeb: Load a .zip resource pack. A resolution selector will open during import.

save.title: Save (folder)
save.description: Write the resource pack as a folder. "Save As" picks a destination each time; "Overwrite" replaces the folder you opened or last saved to.
save.dialogTitle: Choose a destination (parent folder) — a folder named after the resource pack will be created inside

restoredConfirm.title: Overwrite the restored save target?
restoredConfirm.message: The save target "{{path}}" was restored from your last session. Overwriting deletes everything in that folder and writes the pack again. Overwrite it with what you are editing now?

export.title: Export (.zip)
export.description: Save a single .zip file. Useful for sharing / distribution.
export.descriptionWeb: Download the resource pack as a single .zip file.

reset.title: Reset
reset.description: Reset pack info, layout, background, lock images and sounds to their defaults, and forget the overwrite target.
reset.descriptionWeb: Reset pack info, layout, background, lock images and sounds to their defaults.
reset.confirm: Reset all edits (pack info, layout, background, lock images and sounds) to their defaults? You can undo this until you close the app.

embed.label: Include background editing data
embed.hint: Saves the background layer setup (original images, shape positions, colors, gradients) in a wall-maker/ folder so importing the .zip / folder restores each layer. If this is off, importing the exported pack brings the background back as a single flattened image. Minecraft ignores it, but original images increase the file size.

importDialog.title: Import — Select resolution
importDialog.warning: Your current edits will be replaced by the imported pack, and this can't be undone. To keep them, export them first.
importDialog.suggestedDetected: The resource pack's background.png is {{width}} × {{height}} (shown as the suggested default). Change it if the resource pack was made for a different resolution.
importDialog.suggestedMissing: No background.png was found, so the resolution could not be estimated. Please specify one.

layoutEditor.presetHint: Scaled to the current resolution and replaces the whole layout (main, locked and preparing).
layoutEditor.replaceLockedInstancesHint: Off: an instance you lock on the main wall moves to the locked area, and its slot stays empty until you reset all. On: the next instance fills the slot. Only has an effect while the locked area is shown.

areas.mainDescription: The wall itself, where reset instances appear.
areas.preparingDescription: Shows instances that are still generating.

addMenu.shape: Place a rectangle, triangle or ellipse.

background.drawOrderHint: Layers higher in the list are drawn in front. Drag the handle on the left to reorder.
background.visibilityHint: The left toggle hides a layer in the preview and the exported resource pack — hidden layers are not written to background.png.

dnd.instructions: To reorder, press Space to pick up the layer, use the Up and Down arrow keys to move it, and press Space again to drop it. Press Escape to cancel.
dnd.picked: Picked up “{{name}}”. Position {{position}} of {{total}} from the top.
dnd.moved: Moved to position {{position}} of {{total}} from the top.
dnd.dropped: Dropped “{{name}}” at position {{position}} of {{total}} from the top.

adjust.title: Color & blur
adjust.hint: Negative lightness moves toward black, positive toward white. Blur extends the image's edge pixels outward, so the edges stay opaque.

shape.fitHint: Sets the position and size to the selected area, expanded by the padding on every side (negative values shrink it). The shape does not follow the area, so fit it again after moving the area.

toast.notRaster: {{filename}}: unsupported image format (vector formats such as SVG are not supported — use PNG / JPEG / GIF / WebP)

lock.title: Use lock images
lock.description: Turn off to disable the lock overlay.
lock.specNote: The first image is always written as lock.png (if a pack ships only lock-1.png, the mod's built-in lock.png ends up as the first entry). Images are stored as-is without resizing (aspect ratio preserved). Weight controls how often an image is picked: its effective weight divided by the total is the probability.

status.disabled: Disabled: a transparent 128×128 will be written as lock.png on export (blocks the SeedQueue default).
status.emptyEnabled: Enabled with no images: falls back to the mod default lock.png (nothing is written).
status.active: Enabled with {{count}} image(s): the first is written as lock.png; the rest as lock-1.png onward.

weight.label: Weight
weight.hint: Selection weight. Leave empty to follow the default weight. Higher values are picked more often.
weight.defaultDescription: Applied to images without an explicit weight. Written to lock.png's .mcmeta as defaultWeight; omitted when it is 1.

sound.allOffNote: "Silence all events" is on: per-event settings are not exported (the settings are preserved).
sound.resetUnifiedDescription: Consolidate reset_instance / reset_all / reset_column / reset_row into one row.
sound.unifiedRowInfo: Choose "Built-in reset" to play the reset sound only once for reset all / column / row as well (by default it plays once per instance that was reset).
sound.specDefault: default: nothing is written to sounds.json (falls back to mod defaults). Events with built-in sounds (lock_instance / reset_instance) still play.
sound.specOff: off: writes {"replace": true, "sounds": []} to silence the event. For reset all / column / row an empty list falls back to the per-instance reset sound, so a short silent OGG (sounds/custom/silent.ogg) is assigned instead (not needed when the reset sound is off too).
sound.specBuiltin: Built-in reset / lock: references the sound bundled with SeedQueue, e.g. {"replace": true, "sounds": ["seedqueue:reset_instance"]} (no OGG is included).
sound.specCustom: custom: places assets/seedqueue/sounds/custom/<event>.ogg and overrides (built-in sound files are left untouched).
sound.specFormat: Audio formats: playable Ogg Vorbis (1–2 ch) is passed through. Anything else (MP3/WAV/FLAC/AAC/M4A/OPUS/WEBM, or OGG using Opus or 3+ channels) is converted to Ogg Vorbis (q:6, up to 2 ch) via self-hosted ffmpeg.wasm. Core assets (a few MB) are downloaded on first conversion.
sound.unsupported: {{filename}}: unsupported audio format (supported: ogg / mp3 / wav / flac / aac / m4a / opus / webm)

eventInfo.reset_all: There is no dedicated sound by default; the reset sound plays once per instance that was reset. Choose "Built-in reset" to play it only once.
eventInfo.reset_column: There is no dedicated sound by default; the reset sound plays once per instance that was reset. Choose "Built-in reset" to play it only once.
eventInfo.reset_row: There is no dedicated sound by default; the reset sound plays once per instance that was reset. Choose "Built-in reset" to play it only once.
eventInfo.schedule_join: Reserve a not-yet-ready instance to enter automatically as soon as it becomes ready.
eventInfo.schedule_all: Reserve to enter the first instance that becomes ready.
eventInfo.scheduled_join_warning: Plays once when a scheduled instance reaches 95% world generation (a heads-up just before the automatic join).
eventInfo.bypass_wall: Plays when you enter a locked, ready instance directly instead of returning to the wall screen (when SeedQueue's Bypass Wall option is on).

about.title: About SeedQueue Wall Maker
about.appDescription: A GUI for creating and editing resource packs for the <0>SeedQueue</0> Minecraft Speedrunning mod. Same codebase ships a Web build (browser) and a Desktop build (Tauri).
about.appLicenseLine: Copyright (C) 2026 bafv4 and contributors. Licensed under <0>the GNU GPL v3 or later</0>. This program is distributed WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY. See the bundled LICENSE for details.
about.ffmpegIntro: MP3/WAV/AAC/M4A/FLAC/OPUS/WEBM files are converted to Ogg Vorbis using ffmpeg.wasm (FFmpeg compiled to WebAssembly). The core assets are bundled with the app (self-hosted) — no external CDN.
about.ffmpegCore: FFmpeg / @ffmpeg/core — Copyright (c) the FFmpeg developers. The bundled ffmpeg-core.wasm is licensed under GPL v2 or later (ffmpeg.wasm's default core build).
about.ffmpegNote: To satisfy GPL requirements, ffmpeg-core is shipped as a separate, replaceable asset. You can drop your own ffmpeg-core.js / ffmpeg-core.wasm into public/ffmpeg/. See the README for details.
about.languageDescription: Choose the display language. The selection is stored in your browser.

toast.saveSuccess: Saved to {{dest}}. If it is inside your resourcepacks folder, enable it on the Resource Packs screen.
toast.overwriteSuccess: Overwrote {{dest}}. If the pack is enabled, press F3+T in Minecraft to reload it.
toast.overwriteNoTarget: No save target yet — use "Save As" first
toast.persistFailed: Failed to auto-save your edits (export still works)
toast.restoreFailed: Could not restore your previous session — started fresh
toast.saveTargetPersistFailed: Could not remember the save target (saving still works this session)
toast.restoreMissing: {{count}} item(s) could not be restored ({{fields}}). Please add them again.
toast.restoreUnresolved: {{count}} item(s) could not be loaded ({{fields}}). Reloading the app may restore them.
toast.unresolvedBinaries: Cannot export: some data is not loaded ({{fields}}). Reload the app, or set those items again.
toast.unplayableSounds: Cannot export: some sounds can't be played by Minecraft ({{events}}) and would crash SeedQueue. Please choose them again.
